title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Observe the scatterplot carefully. Notice the pattern of the data points. Consider how the function f(x) might transform the x-values to fit the y-values.

title: Considering $$f(x)=-x$$
text: If $$f(x)=-x$$, then the transformation would involve flipping the x-values. Consider how this affects the linearity of the data.

title: Checking Linearity
text: Does applying $$f(x)=-x$$ to the x-values create a linear relationship with the y-values?
